cases.name: older-head-over-full-tiles
cases.says: accept the older signed head using the full tile and bundle

cases.name: full-tile-gone
cases.says: neither partial nor full hash tile is served

cases.name: full-bundle-gone
cases.says: neither partial nor full entry bundle is served

cases.name: corrupt-within-prefix
cases.says: one changed byte in hash 10 inside the older head's prefix

cases.name: corrupt-beyond-prefix
cases.says: one changed byte in hash 200 beyond the older head's prefix

comment: The 162-entry fixture appended twice produces 324 entries, full tiles and deleted width-162 partial paths. The checkpoint is served's unchanged signed and cosigned head at 162. Apply each replacement or deletion over this directory; the case with no mutation accepts it as served.

corrupt-beyond-prefix.says: only its first `W` hashes or entries are then used

corrupt-within-prefix.says: compared with the tree it rebuilt exactly as the partial path would have been

full-bundle-gone.says: `unserved` only when neither the partial path nor the full one is served

full-tile-gone.says: `unserved` only when neither the partial path nor the full one is served
